parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key from metabolism. Inner join compound_records on substrate_record_id to get substrate_compound_key. Inner join compound_structures on that compound_records.molregno to get canonical_smiles. Left join compound_records on metabolite_record_id to get metabolite_compound_key. Sort by all seven output columns ascending. Limit 200.
